limits: Synthetic bounded fixtures only; no representative-PC or realistic-data performance acceptance.

Long form guidance requires scrolling at the tested viewport. Static capture review does not prove absence of transient flicker or high-DPI, multiple-monitor, physical-trackpad or accessibility acceptance.
Methods/CWL contents and Results provenance checked; the separate Methods document dialog was not opened in this screenshot run.
BUS interface consumes a coherent reviewed external BUS bundle; no FASTQ-to-BUS generation, chemistry inference, cell calling or differential expression.
StringTie exposes guided short-read assembly and reference-only estimation; no long/mixed/nascent/merge/Ballgown/raw DE count mode.
Scientific Linux CWL, benchmarking, signing/institutional deployment, representative-PC and release/updater validation remain separate.
